uv-water-filter-ultraviolet-sterilisatio.description:
The **6W UV Water Steriliser with Philips UV-C Lamp** is a compact ultraviolet water treatment system for point-of-use drinking water filtration. Powered by a **12V DC supply**, it features a Philips TUV 6W G6 T5 lamp and stainless steel treatment chamber.

**Key features:**
- Philips TUV 6W G6 T5 germicidal UV-C lamp
- 12V DC system power supply
- 1 GPM flow rate
- Stainless steel UV chamber
- Compact design for point-of-use filtration

**Philips lamp specifications:**
- **Lamp power:** 6W
- **UV-C output:** 1.9W at 100 hours
- **Peak UV-C wavelength:** approximately 253.7 nm
- **Rated useful life:** 9,000 hours
- **Lamp base and format:** G5 / T5

**Applications:** Designed for compact drinking water filtration systems, including suitable under-sink installations. Use with appropriate pre-filtration for best system performance.

**UV safety:** Never look directly at an operating UV-C lamp; UV-C light can injure eyes and skin.

uv-water-filter-ultraviolet-sterilisatio.description:
A **6W ultraviolet water steriliser** using the confirmed **Philips TUV 6W G6 T5** germicidal UV-C lamp. This version uses a **220–240V AC system power supply / ballast**. The lamp itself is the same lamp used in the 12V DC version.

## UV Lamp

- **Lamp manufacturer:** Philips / Signify
- **Lamp model:** Philips TUV 6W G6 T5
- **Philips / Signify product code:** 928000704013
- **Lamp type:** T5 germicidal UV-C lamp
- **Lamp power:** 6W
- **UV-C output:** 1.9W at 100 hours
- **Peak UV-C wavelength:** approximately 253.7 nm (254 nm)
- **Nominal lamp voltage:** 42V
- **Nominal lamp current:** 0.16A
- **Rated useful life:** 9,000 hours
- **Base:** G5
- **Lamp format:** T5
- **Replacement lamp:** Philips TUV 6W G6 T5 / Signify 928000704013

**Important:** 1.9W is the lamp's UV-C radiant output at 100 hours, not its electrical power consumption. Lamp wattage and UV-C output do not establish a reactor dose in mJ/cm².

## UV Reactor / System Specifications

- **System power supply / ballast:** 220–240V AC
- **Reactor flow:** 1 GPM
- **UV chamber:** stainless steel

No UV dose-at-flow claim is inferred from the Philips lamp data.
